title: ProvenanceEnvelope
description: Provenance envelope embedded in every blackboard contribution. Captures the producing KS, the indexed source revision, the deterministic toolchain (with versions) used to build the in-memory SourcerContext consumed by the KS, the sha256 of the rule snapshot driving non-deterministic selection, and any RNG seeds used. Together with ConfidenceEnvelope this is sufficient to reproduce the identification (re-run the KS over a re-derived SourcerContext at the same indexedRevision with the same tool versions, ruleSnapshotSha256 and seeds).

ks.description: Fully-qualified producing KS identifier including version (e.g. 'itip:java:StructureIdentificationKs@1.3.0').

indexedRevision.description: Identifier of the source revision indexed (typically a git commit sha, optionally suffixed with worktree dirty marker).

tools.description: Deterministic tools used to build the in-memory SourcerContext consumed by the KS.

ruleSnapshotSha256.description: Sha256 of the rule snapshot driving any non-deterministic selection embedded in the KS.

seeds.description: RNG seeds used by non-deterministic selection (e.g. Leiden community detection).
